text:
Kara: new dev hitting import error on edge: "Cannot find module 'redwood-js-sdk'" when deploying sample.
Dev: is this pnpm or npm? some packagers pick main->cjs if exports absent.
Kara: project uses pnpm, but reproduces with npm too. local node works.
Robin: missing conditional exports is the usual suspect. add exports with import/require and an /edge subpath.
Yusuf: also ensure top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" — do not rely on types inside exports yet.
Kara: our ESM edge entry also inlined node-only helpers (node:crypto, setImmediate) which broke retries.
Dev: fix plan: 1) add exports map: dot import->esm, require->cjs, './edge'->dist/esm/edge.mjs; 2) create tiny edge-entry that uses only web APIs.
Robin: 3) refactor auth into src/auth/core.ts, build to dist/auth/core.{mjs,cjs} and externalize so both bundles import same core and share retry behavior.
Yusuf: 4) update sample to runtime-detect edge and do: const path = isEdge ? 'redwood-js-sdk/edge' : 'redwood-js-sdk'; const SDK = await import(path);
Kara: 5) add CI matrix: pnpm/npm/yarn + wrangler/vercel dev smoke to catch resolution/runtime issues.
Dev: I'll open PRs for exports + edge entry. Robin will handle auth/core and build changes. Yusuf add CI. CI-bot: queued job devex/edge-smoke/sample-run.
Kara: Thanks — this should clear onboarding friction and keep typing parity intact.
